warmup: Sam here. Zippy’s sign says fastest on the beach, ninety steps! Hmm. Drag a word magnet onto each blank, so the sign only says what the number proves. Wrong words slide right off.
part2: Different distance, different time. Here’s a fair trick. Press Run. Every ten seconds the robot stops, and you press Cut. Then compare one piece from each robot, side by side.
explore: Time for a fair rematch. Drag the finish flag onto the tape, or tap a mark. Press Start the race and watch both race clocks. Then type your numbers into the data table.
evidence: A classmate says you can tell who’s fastest just by watching. True? Think about Zippy’s sign, and the race clocks. Pick your side, tap two facts, then explain. That’s your C-E-R.
